items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I used to get the Duke Ellington band

ctx.x: That probably would have expanded your listening and access to hearing a lot of music?
Oh, I don’t know... I just remember having the radio. I used to listen to that. I used to get the Duke Ellington band... They were playing broadcasts for War Bonds.

I remember all the stories that your aunts would tell about...at your grandmother’s house... There was a lot of music in the house. They used to roll back the rugs and dance, and your mother played ukelele...
